description: Cross-SDK vectors for the auth_context claim mappers (Go FromXClaims, TypeScript fromX, Python from_x). Each case runs the same verified claims and overrides through the named helper (any provider other than workos, clerk, auth0, supabase and firebase uses the generic OIDC helper with that slug); the JSON every SDK sends must equal expect exactly. Rules the vectors pin: contact verification comes from token claims only for Auth0 (email_verified and phone_number_verified), from overrides for every provider; a NumericDate is written as RFC 3339 in whole UTC seconds, the fraction truncated; string claims split on whitespace (OAuth scope, RFC 6749 section 3.3), and Clerk permissions also on commas; Clerk's role is one slug; Clerk never sends issued_at from iat (a 60-second refresh clock; session age is the session_created_at override); Auth0 amr lists every method except pwd, and an amr of only pwd sends no mfa; the first-class adapters always send impersonated, false included; an override replaces the mapped value, false included. Unknown, mistyped, out-of-range and out-of-contract claims map to absent, never to a stronger assurance: a case with "error": true must be refused (a TypeError, ValueError or the language's equivalent) because issuer or subject is missing or invalid or the provider slug is not a lowercase slug; Clerk fva counts only a numeric second factor from 0 to ten years of minutes; Auth0 amr counts only an array of strings; a time string must be RFC 3339; and token claims never raise assurance_level: the only value any claim sends is low, for an anonymous user (Supabase is_anonymous or app_metadata.provider anonymous, Firebase sign_in_provider anonymous), and only an exact boolean true or the exact string anonymous counts. Supabase aal2 is mfa present with the second-factor methods from amr (a slash becomes a colon), aal1 is mfa present false, and any other aal sends no mfa. Firebase reads only its reserved claims, so custom claims named role, sid, tenant, amr, aal, email_verified or anything else never change the result; contact verification there comes from overrides.
